LanguageData.CC_R2Dig_CaughtShout: Hey, get away from those graves!
LanguageData.CC_R2Dig_Caught: {A_nameDef} caught {X_nameDef} of the {NAME} digging at the old graves in the night, after the colony told them to keep to the ruins. {X_nameDef} went back to their camp, and the camp is sore about being caught.
LanguageData.CC_R2Dig_Found: Someone has been digging at the old graves in the night: the earth over one of them is turned. The {NAME} say they know nothing about it.
LanguageData.CC_R2Dig_Share: The {NAME} are packing up, and {X_nameDef} is carrying the colony's share of what they found to its gate: {THING}.
LanguageData.CC_R2Dig_ShareLeft: The {NAME} are packing up. Nobody of theirs was free to carry the colony's share over, so they left it at the edge of their camp: {THING}.
LanguageData.CC_R2Dig_NoGraves: There are no old graves on the land to dig.
LanguageData.CC_R2Dig_GravesImpact: They dig the old graves too, and bring a second thing for the colony's share; those who hold to the keeper of the dead are unhappy for a few days
LanguageData.CC_R2Herd_Met: The {NAME}'s coughing beasts and the colony's {THING} came close to each other.
LanguageData.CC_R2Herd_FluMet: The cough of the {NAME}'s herd has spread to the colony's own animals: they came too close to each other.
LanguageData.CC_R2Herd_FluTended: The cough of the {NAME}'s herd has come to the colony's own animals, carried back by whoever tended the herders' beasts.
LanguageData.CC_R2Herd_TendImpact: {0} spends a couple of hours beside the herders' coughing beasts (practice in animals); afterwards there is some chance the colony's own animals catch the cough
LanguageData.CC_R2Stone_Place_tree: by the oldest tree on the land
LanguageData.CC_R2Stone_Place_open: on open ground by their camp
LanguageData.CC_R2Stone_Place_edge: at the edge of the land
LanguageData.CC_R2Stone_Laid: The {NAME} have laid out the place for their stone {THING}, and are starting to raise it.
LanguageData.CC_R2Stone_Told: People of {FACTION} raised a stone to {GOD} on the colony's land, and kept a rite at it when it stood.
LanguageData.CC_R2Stone_Stands: The {NAME}'s {THING} stands. They are keeping a short rite at it, and are leaving it to the colony.
LanguageData.CC_R2Stone_PlaceImpact: They raise the stone where they asked and leave it to the colony
LanguageData.CC_R2Stone_PlaceImpactBrief: the stone raised where they asked
LanguageData.CC_R2Smug_WalkLabel: a walk out to the smugglers' lamp
LanguageData.CC_R2Smug_WalkOut: {A_nameDef} walked out to the {NAME}'s lamp after dark with {COUNT} silver from the colony's stores, and one of them is bringing back a {THING} to the gate.
LanguageData.CC_R2Smug_TheLaw: the people whose law it is
LanguageData.CC_R2Smug_TellImpact: {FACTION} think better of the colony; the smugglers leave when night falls and don't come back
LanguageData.CC_R2Nov_Exchanged: {A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} of the {NAME} told each other stories of their gods at the novices' fire.
LanguageData.CC_R2Nov_NoPlace: The colony has no place dedicated to a god.
LanguageData.CC_R2Nov_TaleImpact: {0} walks over to their fire and tells them a story of the colony's gods; they tell one back, and the colony's book hears it
LanguageData.CC_R2Nov_KneelImpact: They walk to the colony's holy place and kneel there a while
LanguageData.CC_R2Nov_KneelImpactBrief: they kneel at the holy place
LanguageData.CC_R2Hunt_Killed: {X_nameDef} and the {NAME} brought down the {THING} they came for.
LanguageData.CC_R2Hunt_KilledAnyway: One of the {NAME} went after the {THING} anyway and killed it, after the colony asked them to leave it alone.
LanguageData.CC_R2Hunt_NoBeast: The beast they came for is gone.
LanguageData.CC_R2Away_Told: {FACTION} put away {GOD} after a hard year and took down its stones.
LanguageData.CC_R2Away_PriestImpact: The priest camps by the colony for a season, keeps the god's rite and tells its tales
LanguageData.CC_R2Away_NoRoom: There is no room for another camp on the land now.
LanguageData.CC_R2Dance_JoinLine: I can't keep still listening to that!
LanguageData.CC_R2Dance_QuietLine: Could you please stop that noise for a while?
LanguageData.CC_R2Dance_Dancing: {COUNT} dancers of {FACTION} are dancing at the colony's gate.
LanguageData.CC_R2Dance_Fever: {PAWN_nameDef} caught the dancing fever from the dancers who slept here: restless for about a day, it goes by itself.
LanguageData.CC_R2Dead_SayWhole: Leave our dead whole, where they were laid.
LanguageData.CC_R2Dead_SaySoil: They belong in the soil, so leave them there.
LanguageData.CC_R2Dead_Rose: The earth over the colony's oldest grave ({GRAVE}) broke open in the night, and something that was dead is walking toward the colony.
LanguageData.CC_R2Dead_BurnImpact: Up to {0} of the colony's graves are marked to be taken up, and a bill to cremate the dead is set at the crematorium
LanguageData.CC_R2Coin_LedgerLine: Good coin always finds its way back to honest hands.
